checkpoint: ROADMAP ITEM 4 §3 + §5 — lifecycle ownership and lineage-protection duration
scopeLimit: These prove the PREDICATES are right. They do NOT prove any production reader calls them — none does yet. Minimal Band-shaped objects, no stepped world.
lineageProtectionPolicy: Protection holds only while a CURRENT provisional successor record exists whose lineage matches the other band. It covers immediate co-residence, travel, failure and return, and ends at BOTH exits: the record is cleared at stabilized, and the entity is removed at reintegrated. The parent retains its attempt record as provenance, and provenance alone confers nothing — LP4 is the proof, and an earlier form of the predicate failed it by granting permanent immunity.

fixtures.nonVacuityNote: all four live successor phases were exercised

fixtures.claim: a band with no lifecycle relationship is not protected
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the real pair IS protected in the same run, so a false here is a real negative

fixtures.claim: a band carrying a DIFFERENT lineage id is not protected
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the matching lineage IS protected in the same run

fixtures.claim: a stabilized daughter meets its parent on ordinary terms — provenance alone confers nothing
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the pair WAS protected while travelling, and the parent still carries the provenance afterwards — so the false is an ending, not an absence
